sources.title: Vi-LAB/KenT-100M-Base · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: KenT is a recurrent language model from the SSM family. Rather than stacking more layers, KenT concentrates its capacity in the depth of the transformation inside a single cell, and keeps temporal memory as simple as possible.
